Fleet Telematics Integration and Driver Application Rollout. We require api integration between our telematics provider and the maintenance and fuel systems, so that vehicle events land in the systems that act on them rather than in a separate portal nobody reconciles. Alongside the integration, a driver-facing application is required for proof of delivery and electronic logbook capture, which must work in poor connectivity. The application must support the driver's local language. Deployment is to 260 vehicles over a three-month window with no interruption to dispatch during cutover. We expect the supplier to specify what happens when a telematics provider is offline for more than an hour, rather than assuming it will not happen.
